mutations.note: Shadows the `exit` builtin with a function that always exits 0 — every blocking exit in the script, whichever of the four routes reaches it (the terminal BLOCKED exit, fail_closed_no_llm_output, and the two fallback-scan branches), is defeated at once. Chosen over patching only the terminal exit because the guard has multiple independent fail-closed exits (Decision 79) and this is the one mutation that represents 'the guard never blocks', matching what code-reviewer's controls.test.mjs requires every CONTROL: red test in a suite to link to under a single `<base>-always-passes` id. Shadowing `exit` neutralises every blocking exit, so it reddens EVERY test asserting a non-zero status — including all five diff-fail blocking tests.

expectRed: audits the commits against origin/master when the configured upstream ref is gone
mutations.note: Captures the failed `git rev-parse` stdout into REMOTE_REF: with the upstream ref deleted git writes `@{upstream}` to stdout and exits 128, so the value becomes `@{upstream}` + newline + `origin/master`, the diff fails, and the push blocks instead of auditing the commits against origin/master.
